title: Sundance
specs: Infrared sauna burns calories, relieves muscle soreness, and detoxifies
Massage therapists skilled in Swedish, deep tissue, sports, myofascial, and trigger point therapy
Arrive at least 5 minutes before first sauna appointment to complete paperwork
